description: Source code for the Si7210 sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including register definitions, device initialization, power management, and data fetching functions.

methods.name: si7210_sleep
methods.description: Puts the Si7210 device into sleep mode by disabling measurements and setting sleep bit.

methods.name: si7210_wakeup
methods.description: Wakes the Si7210 device from sleep or idle mode by reading a byte from the device.

methods.name: si7210_reset
methods.description: Resets the Si7210 device by putting it to sleep and waking it up.

methods.name: si7210_otp_reg_read_byte
methods.description: Reads a byte from a specified OTP register of the device.

methods.name: si7210_read_sn
methods.description: Reads the serial number from the device's OTP registers.

methods.name: si7210_set_dspsigsel
methods.description: Sets the DSPSIGSEL register if not already set to the specified value.

methods.name: si7210_set_arautoinc
methods.description: Sets the ARAUTOINC register if not already set to the specified value.

methods.name: si7210_sample_fetch_one
methods.description: Fetches a single sample from the device for a specified channel.

methods.name: si7210_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches samples for all supported channels.

methods.name: si7210_channel_get
methods.description: Converts raw samples into sensor values for temperature and magnetic field.

methods.name: si7210_init
methods.description: Initializes the device, reads device info, and configures default settings.
